title: The Canopy Beyond Classification

features.name: the growth that refused its row
features.desc-on-touch: Here the orchard learned to break its own pattern. Each tree speaks only its own grammar. The archive stopped trying to make a list.

features.name: the speaking canopy
features.desc-on-touch: Leaves learn to speak before roots ever stop growing. The archive listens—no two leaves say the same thing twice.

features.name: unmapped understandings
features.desc-on-touch: The space where growth tangles too thickly to map. Plants teach the archive that naming was the wrong question all along.

features.name: the fence-line giving up
features.desc-on-touch: Where the orchard's boundary learned there was no boundary. Growth spilled in both directions; the fence stayed still; the archive learned to do the same.

features.name: the tangling that teaches
features.desc-on-touch: Roots, vine, stone—all learning each other's language at once. The archive reads the tangle and stops calling it disorder.

reverie.title: REVERIE — walking where the orchard grew too much
narr: You couldn't map it anymore—rows gone,
names failing. She laughed at your notebook.
"The archive was wrong," she said, "to think
it could hold this." Leaves fell around you both.
learned to walk in circles and call it true.

inscription: growth refuses to be still; the archive learned to accept what exceeds naming
